facts.text: A security guard is wanted by Philadelphia police after shooting a man during a confrontation outside a club on the 1000 block of Spring Garden Street early Sunday.
Nightlife violence in Philadelphia hasn't been limited to guard-involved shootings.

In July 2025, a physical fight on an exterior balcony at 7 Elements bar and lounge in South Philadelphia escalated into a mass shooting that injured eight people, including two 43-year-old male security guards, according to WHYY.
Investigators say the guard pulled out a gun and shot the man before running from the scene.
The shooting adds to a string of recent incidents in which armed security personnel have used lethal force during confrontations at Philadelphia bars, clubs, and event venues.
In October 2025, a female security guard at a Center City IHOP on Walnut Street fatally shot a male customer following a late-night dispute, as previously reported by FOX 29 Philadelphia.

The city passed a broader measure, Chapter 9-6800, in 2025 to mandate additional safety training for commercial security officers, but the Philadelphia Department of Labor announced in February that enforcement is postponed until city-approved training provider criteria are finalized.

Officers responded to the 1000 block of Spring Garden Street at about 12:30 a.m. for a reported shooting.
According to investigators, the man had just left a party on the block when he became involved in a dispute with a security guard.
"There's a lot of work to be done, and we believe there is footage in the area that may have captured some or all of the incident," Philadelphia police Inspector D.F.
Anyone with information about the shooting is asked to contact Philadelphia police.
